verdict.rationale: vLLM exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server (plus Anthropic Messages API and tool calling/reasoning parsers) which coding agents can target as an inference backend, and community evidence confirms this OpenAI-compatible interface is used in practice for integration. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'agent backend' guide, official coding-agent integration examples, or MCP-style connector — the story is only satisfied indirectly via generic API compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of coding-agent integration (e.g. Cursor/Copilot/agent framework setup guides), first-party MCP or agent-specific connector, hands-on confirmation from an agent developer.
